arguments.interpolation_mode_rule: non-interpolated axes retain the exact query coordinates; nodes are fresh native values, not values scattered or averaged from other spacecraft states
arguments.log_altitude_width_rule: uniform in ln(altitude_km); the width equals ln(1 + cell_altitude_km / altitude_reference_km), so a cell is cell_altitude_km wide at the reference altitude

metadata.density_only_api_contract: these candidates cache density in kg/m^3 only. DirectAtmosphere::evaluate additionally returns temperature_k, exospheric_temperature_k and (NRLMSISE-00 only) eight species number densities, so a density-only cache cannot substitute for the production Result contract. Every caller that needs those fields must use DensityEvaluator::authoritative, which is never cached. The coupled RHS in experiment.cpp consumes density_kg_m3 only, so that one call path is preservable; the public provider contract is not.
metadata.evidence_class: scientific-native-input-partial: pinned NRLMSISE-00/CSSI/UTC, no provider or trajectory claims
metadata.input_pinning_rule: the hashes below are of the files this process actually read; a mismatch against the pinned direct-v2 hashes is the caller's decision to declare with --study-verification-only and never something this tool resolves on its own
metadata.kernel_invalidation_rule: an opaque Sun observation stamps the managed SPICE generation; each cache query checks its compatibility and discards all stored values after managed invalidation
metadata.longitude_wrap_rule: longitude cell indices are wrapped onto the periodic grid, so the +180/-180 seam is a single cell boundary and never a duplicated cell
metadata.measurement_scope: PARTIAL: NRLMSISE-00 is queried through the production adapter at explicit Earth-fixed geodetic coordinates and absolute UTC instants. No provider, no Earth-orientation preprocessing, no trajectory, no coupled RHS and no end-to-end quantity is measured. These numbers are not comparable with a direct-v2 baseline and must not be read as provider, preprocessing or performance evidence.
metadata.model_native_altitude_source: NRLMSISE-00 reference input range, 0-1000 km geodetic
metadata.native_authority: every non-reconstructed value is a fresh native evaluation; reconstructed values are documented combinations of stored native values only
metadata.native_definition_of_invalid: a native density that is not finite and positive is counted and reported, never replaced or concealed
metadata.not_used_inputs: ["planetary ephemeris","Earth orientation kernel","JB2008 SOLFSMY and DTCFILE records"]
metadata.out_of_contract_node_rule: a reconstruction is refused when any cell it would need lies outside the model's own native altitude range, so no out-of-contract node is ever evaluated and no valid query is forced onto a cell that cannot be built
metadata.payload_estimate_note: cache payload bytes are reported separately from the process peak RSS: the payload is the cache's own cost, the RSS is everything the process used
metadata.polar_fallback_rule: a query with |latitude| above the fallback limit is served by the native model only; a uniform longitude cell is degenerate there, so no cell boundary is invented
metadata.preprocessing_options: UTC civil-day reuse, exact-epoch Earth orientation reuse and shared Sun observation are all enabled, exactly as in the direct-v2 baseline
metadata.threading: one evaluator per thread; DensityEvaluator is process-local and not thread safe
metadata.weather_guard_rule: every cache key carries the model's complete discrete space-weather vector bitwise, not a hash of it, together with the UTC civil day, the leap-day flag and the Ap-history switch. A single differing bit is a different key, so no stored, cell-reused or interpolated value can cross a daily solar or Ap boundary, a 3-hourly Ap bin, an hourly DTC record, an integer DSTDTC transition inside an hour, a switch-vector change or UTC midnight
metadata.weather_identity_comparison: bitwise equality of the full vector; a 64-bit summary is reported for convenience and is never used to decide whether a value may be reused
metadata.weather_identity_definition: one free function, cache_study::weather_identity(config, env, model, epoch), called by DensityEvaluator::build_inputs and available to any analysis that must decide whether two epochs may share a stored or interpolated value; it copies the model's complete discrete space-weather vector bitwise and is never hashed for a decision
